name: sghimire/mobile-browser
description: Native in-app browser (WKWebView / android.webkit.WebView) and external browser launcher, free alternative to a paid browser plugin. Ships its own facade, fluent open builder, events, and JS bindings.

bridge_functions.name: MobileBrowser.Open
bridge_functions.description: Open a URL either in a full-screen in-app browser view (mode=webview, default) with its own toolbar, navigation controls and share button, or hand it off to the device's external default browser app (mode=external). Returns immediately once the request is accepted; the real outcome (page opened, or dismissed/failed) arrives later via the Opened and Closed events.

bridge_functions.name: MobileBrowser.Close
bridge_functions.description: Programmatically dismiss the currently open in-app browser view or in-progress OAuth session, as if the user tapped close/cancel. Fires Closed with reason 'closed_by_app'. Has no effect on a URL opened in the external browser.

bridge_functions.name: MobileBrowser.Auth
bridge_functions.description: Run an OAuth authorization-code flow: present the given authorize URL in a secure, isolated system browser context (ASWebAuthenticationSession on iOS, Custom Tabs + a dedicated redirect activity on Android) and capture the redirect to redirectUri. Returns immediately once the session is presented; the outcome arrives later via AuthCompleted (with the full callback URL and its parsed query/fragment parameters) or Closed (user cancelled, or the flow failed).
